answer: Every identity must lock a slashable bond before it can post or trade, and that bond only vests after established peers grade its work across a full epoch. Picture a grove where each tree holds one thread to the commons, or a lagoon where each boat must anchor before it sails: one identity, one anchor. A sybil farmer must fund, season, and risk a separate bond for every fake, and one proven link between fakes burns every linked bond at once, so each extra identity costs real capital instead of being free.
